text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To keep seizing overwhelming victories.
That is the path I walk as the strong—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to walk this path together with me,
then please, follow along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
